Q: authentication for wkhtmltopdf on domino server A:

You can try converting pages that require authentication into PDF files by using the existing session or cookies when running the command prompt.

  1. First, log in to the website.
  2. Open the devtools (F12), go to the “Applications” tab, and click “Cookies”.
  3. Check the cookie name and value that corresponding to the authenticated user session.
  4. Finally, run the command prompt using the cookie information as shown in the example below.
wkhtmltopdf --cookie "CookieName" "Value" http://server/database.nsf/view/B067E9B04AC2B3FAC225835C004D211B thedoc.pdf

Q: While cycling through a zsh completion menu, do not update the command line until a menu item has been chosen A:

In zsh there are two different completion behaviors that often get conflated:

  1. menu-complete

    • Cycling (TAB / SHIFT-TAB) inserts each candidate into the buffer as you move.

    • This is the behavior you don’t want.

  2. menu-select

    • Opens a selectable menu.

    • Moving around the menu does not modify the command line.

    • The buffer is only updated when you accept the selection (Enter, Space, etc.).

So the fix is basically: switch to menu-select.

Minimal, clean solution

1. Enable menu selection style

zstyle ':completion:*' menu select

This tells compsys: when showing a menu, use interactive selection.

2. Bind TAB to menu-select

This is the crucial part. If TAB is bound to menu-complete, you’ll still get live updates.

bindkey '^I' menu-select

(^I is TAB)

Optional but nice:

bindkey '^[[Z' reverse-menu-select   # Shift-TAB

3. Make sure you’re NOT forcing menu-complete

Check that you don’t have this somewhere:

bindkey '^I' menu-complete

or:

setopt MENU_COMPLETE

If you do, remove or disable it:

unsetopt MENU_COMPLETE

Resulting behavior

  • Press TAB → menu appears

  • Use arrows / TAB / SHIFT-TAB to move

  • Command line stays unchanged

  • Press Enter / Space → selected item is inserted

Exactly what you asked for.

If you want this only sometimes

You can scope it:

zstyle ':completion:*:*:*:*' menu select

or per-command:

zstyle ':completion:*:git:*' menu select

To make it feel extra clean

zstyle ':completion:*' menu select
zstyle ':completion:*' list-colors ${(s.:.)LS_COLORS}

Q: Kotlin Multiplatform Library with compose UI elements used in androidMain A:

EDIT: For simplicity, refer to the official JetBrains KMP template gallery for building multiplatform libraries: https://kmp.jetbrains.com/templates

Looking at your code, I was able to reproduce your error in an existing project of mine by using:

implementation(platform(libs.compose.bom)) // ❌ Now deprecated

instead of the now recommended:

implementation(project.dependencies.platform(libs.compose.bom)) // ✅ Use this

So my best guess to resolve this issue would be to change to the latter.
In the latest version of IntelliJ IDEA (which I recommend for KMP development), it marks platform as deprecated with the message:

'fun platform(notation: Any): Dependency' is deprecated. Scheduled for removal in Kotlin 2.1. Check KT-58759.

Q: Which Hamcrest matcher to import A:

org.hamcrest.Matchers

This is the Hamcrest library class that contains assertion helpers.

Examples inside this class:

  • equalTo()

  • notNullValue()

  • greaterThan()

  • lessThan()

  • containsString()
